Explore deep beneath the Boondaburra Forest, and discover The Underworld! An old cave network that leads through a spectacular aquifer, filled with mystery and wonder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41128920/784a02e3063acc2a731a1f890185097aa64f531b.png

[previewyoutube=rXM7Xqo8Yb4;full][/previewyoutube]

Update 1.3

In addition to the new area, I've also added new items and equipment, re-worked the boss fights, added a good variety of new wildlife and a bunch of new quality of life and accessibility features.

I hope you dig this update, and as always feedback is always appreciated! Share it with me in the Platypus Adventures discord server: https://discord.gg/euQg72B


Platypus Adventures 1.3 patch notes

Core changes

- Upgraded engine to Unreal Engine 5.4.3
- Added colour blind accessibility options
- Added an optional contextual controls overlay
- Added auto detect graphics settings to scale graphics based on the system
- Added resolution settings and automatic resolution detection
- Added a "Cayote Time" system to improve platforming gameplay
- Added a Level Select menu option in the main menus
- The inventory can now be operated with the 1,2,3,4,5 keys on the keyboard
- Added a quicksave button for keyboard (F6)
- Changed the reflection method to utilize Lumen reflections

New Content: Items and equipment

- Added an equippable Slingshot ranged weapon
- Added Mushroom pickup item
- Added Spike Seed pickup item
- Added Ghost Mushroom 3 piece cosmetic set (Backpack, Hat and Armour pieces)

New Content: Characters

- Added Stingray character
- Added Blue Tang character
- Added Blacktip Reef Shark character
- Added Scrub Turkey character
- Added Scorpion character
- Added Crow character
- Added Snail character
- Added Goby Character
- Added Clownfish character
- Added Seahorse character
- Added Centipede character
- Added Blind Cave Eel character
- Added Hermit Crab character
- Added playable character for split screen mode "K. Wala"
- Added playable character for split screen mode "E. Kidna"

World changes

- Added new area "The Underworld" located in the Forest
- Added more world ambient sounds
- Added a small area behind the waterfall at Green Hill in the Forest
- Added a few flocks of birds that fly towards the new content "The Underworld" in the Forest
- Re-worked Snake's boss arena and boss fight
- Re-worked Sea Eagle's boss fight
- Re-worked Crocodile's arena and boss fight
- Added an avoidable heat system to the desert
- Added more covered areas in the desert, to compliment the new desert heat system
- Reworked various elements of the world layout

Balance and adjustments

- Ladders now require the player to use an input to trigger, to avoid accidental climbing
- Added underwater attack animations to Platy
- Seagulls will now land on Platy and provide direct combat support
- The heavy logs at the dam in the desert can now be attacked and destroyed
- Added the ability to parry attacks from small creatures
- Picking up items will no longer temporarily stop Platy's movement
- Objects in the world will fade out when too close to the camera
- The new game screen now resemble the start of the game
- The new game screen now contains the full settings menu
- Increased player steering response while swimming
- Disabled player attacks while poisoned
- Increased Snake boss health and damage output
- Added random movement to some friendly characters where appropriate
- Added a colour fade out to the death camera
- Added a body to first person camera mode
- Adjusted the first person camera position to properly match Platy's eye position
- Increased Sun and Moon light intensity
- Increased night time duration
- Decreased enemy attack speed while underwater
- Cassowary now helps to fight back the attackers before the Snake boss fight
- Adjusted the look of water to improve the underwater/above water separation
- Increased the damage taken from Boulders
- Increased enemy movement speed

Fixes

- Fixed various issues related to Split Screen mode
- Fixed an issue where some inventory actions would become visible at incorrect times
- Fixed an issue where Windowed mode was not working properly
- Fixed an issue where some graphics settings where not being saved correctly
- Fixed an issue where pickup item text would sometimes display in the incorrect location
- Fixed an issue where some pickup items could not be interacted with
- Fixed an issue where riding Cassowary or Emu would reset the player camera position
- Fixed an issue where the camera position could not be changed while riding cassowary or emu
- Fixed an issue where the text prompt to ride Cassowary or Emu would sometimes show incorrectly
- Fixed an issue where friendly characters where sometimes not buoyant while submerged in water
- Fixed an issue where reversing the canoe would cause it to drift in the wrong direction
- Fixed an issue where Platy was forced to stop riding Cassowary in the centre of the forest village
- Fixed an issue where some music was repeating unintentionally
- Fixed an issue where a quest marker was appearing unintentionally in the Forest area
- Fixed an issue where Echidna sometimes would not clear a swinging vine gap
- Fixed an issue where Crocodile would sometimes become knocked out of position during a scene
- Fixed an issue where some characters where not appearing when loading into the world
- Fixed an issue where the Snake boss would sometimes not appear at the start of the battle
- Fixed an issue where the Snake boss would sometimes dissapear after constricting the player
- Fixed an issue where the Snake boss music would sometimes not play
- Fixed an issue where the diving animation was being triggered while using the swinging vine
- Fixed an issue where the underwater post processing would display incorrectly
- Fixed an issue where birds would sometimes spawn underwater
- Fixed an issue where some fish and birds would spawn unable to move
- Fixed an issue where some fish would swim at an incorrect angle
- Fixed an issue where surfing a wave while picking up an item could soft lock platy
- Fixed an issue where a Turtle in Yaringa village would repeatedly accept payment
- Fixed an issue with the water bucket where it would clip through the ground if you fell
- Fixed an issue where Platy could be burned by fire despite dousing it with water
- Fixed an issue where holding the jump button could cause a soft lock
- Additional fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Patch 1.3 incoming!
notes.content:
I'm excited to share that patch 1.3 will be releasing this month, on the 15th!
I've been testing it extensively, and am satisfied with the new content and hope you will enjoy it.

There's 13 new animals, a whole new area to explore "The Underworld" and a wide range of new features and improvements! Split screen mode I've given alot of attention to, refining the gamemode more and I added some new playable characters for splitscreen aswell!

Can't wait to get it out to people and hear your opinion!

Cheers,
David

notes.title: Platypus Adventures Update 1.2 - Blackrock Island
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41128920/d92a7aa79b58156761e6df29a8a5b5d0ecd666a9.png

Set sail and discover the new explorable region, Blackrock Island! I've worked hard on this update since the launch of the game, and I'm happy to finally share it with you!

I would like to thank everyone who purchased the game and has supported it with your feedback, live streams, videos and artwork! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41128920/5c46dc0eb71b9ebfc7f323eae5550e1e14b445d4.png

Update 1.2

The focus of this update was the new Blackrock Island region, but a significant amount of work has gone into the original campaign too, upgrading it to Unreal Engine 5 was a big task for me but I am really happy with the results. The new lighting system "Lumen" has created a really great result on the world, resulting in a huge visual upgrade in all of the older areas. I've spent some time addressing a wide range of accumulated feedback gathered from the community to improve the quality of life in the game. 

I hope you enjoy this update, and as always feedback is always appreciated! Share it with me in the Platypus Adventures discord server: https://discord.gg/euQg72B


Core Upgrades

- Game upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.1.1
- Enabled Lumen lighting system
- Improved Mac OSX performance with updated graphics settings

World

- Added large explorable region "Blackrock Island"
- Added another tree-house in the Forest area
- Added a new dock area in the Ocean area, with a ship to transport to Blackrock Island

Characters

- Added Owl character voiced by Pete Richards
- Added Great White Shark character
- Added small Dragonfly character
- Added more Turtle characters
- Added more Koala characters
- Added more Kangaroo characters
- Added more Wombat characters

Items and Equipment

- Added Cup Of Fruit Juice
- Added Shark Repel
- Added Crystal Armour
- Added Crystal Helmet
- Added Crystal Boomerang
- Added fighting training dummy

Gameplay

- Added a diving mission type
- Added a rescue mission type
- Added a simple healing character/doctor system
- Added leafball mini game
- Added fighting arena
- Added jump into water dive system
- Added a fall damage system that scales based on air time (Normal difficulty and above)
- Added Flying Kick heavy attack
- Added a slow motion effect while landing heavy attacks (disabled for split-screen)

Adjustments

- Added a numbers to the health bar showing your current health value, and incoming damage
- Added a critter spawning system
- Added assorted chest pieces to various enemy types
- Heavy attacks will cycle between available moves
- Heavy attacks now deal stagger damage, instead of regular damage
- Standard enemy attack parry window will scale in seconds based on difficulty
- Dyanamic camera movement based on undercover
- Main menu re-worked
- Enabled cinematic graphics options
- Adjusted the Crystal Material on Crocodile's staff
- Adjusted the mount system with new animations
- Added a bobbing motion to the canoe
- Adjusted Volumetric Cloud material
- Adjusted water material
- Adjusted underwater material
- Adjusted ocean wave material
- Adjusted waterfall material
- Adjusted melonball to no longer cut to external camera between rounds
- Adjusted melonball game to display "melonball" in the bottom right of the screen as you begin to play 
- Baby Cassowary can no longer recieve damage, and will not play a damage animation if attacked
- New sets of armour will replace the existing set, instead of stacking
- Challenge mode is now a fixed difficulty and cannot be changed
- Disabled HUD and tutorials in Challenge mode
- Reduced melee distance between platy and friendly characters
- Attack damage increases with the hit counter
- Adjusted the heavy attack hit counter thresholds

Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the day night cycle would sometimes get stuck
- Fixed a memory leak in the main menu
- Fixed a memory leak in challenge mode
- Fixed an issue where the Boomerang could become stuck being aimed
- Fixed an issue where using the Lantern during a cutscene with Cassowary could cause a glitch
- Fixed an issue where you could gain the Flower Crown without using the boomerang
- Fixed multiple issues with various boundaries
- Fixed an issue where you could take off your hat mid-air
- Fixed an issue where sand-sliding would leave platy moving at a slightly slower speed
- Fixed an issue where the fall damage animation / mechanic could be bypassed
- Fixed some floating out-of-place geometry at the entrance to the the deep sea area
- Fixed a visual glitch that used to happen during the transition from afternoon to night in the sky
- Fixed an issue where pearls would sometimes clip beneath clams when opened
- Fixed an issue where items could become unresponsive to pickup input
- Fixed an issue where items could not be picked up in immersive mode
- Fixed an issue where the heavy attack prompt sometimes wouldn't show
- Fixed an issue where dodge rolling would sometimes push you in the wrong direction
- Fixed an issue where Platy could move characters with the boomerang

notes.title: Platypus Adventures version 1.1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LtFgxYjP-qA;full][/previewyoutube]

Platypus Adventures version 1.1

Content update focused on new areas and features

Note: If you are trying the new Challenge Mode and have a previous save on older build, I recommended that you reset your game (in main menu) to get a clean set of statistics

New Content

- Added Challenge Mode
- Added achievement "Challenger" (Complete the campaign with Challenge Mode)
- Added game progression percentage to Main Menu
- Re-modelled Platy's Old Hat
- Added Legendary Helmet
- Added Flower Crown
- Added Old Gum Nut Hat
- Added new area in Platy's home
- Added character switch in Platy's home
- Added new area near Kalamunda Village for Old Gum Nut Hat
- Added new area in the Deep Sea, for Legendary Helmet
- Added additional idle waiting animations for Platy

Adjustments

- The game now loads into a main menu, instead of loading into gameplay directly
- Boulder trap + Palm Falling trap can now be triggered with Boomerang
- Adjusted main menu
- Adjustments to gamepad look control
- Increased the damage of the Boomerang and Advanced Boomerang
- Increased the damage of the Cactus Bludgeoner
- Added a cheat code to unlock the Cactus Bludgeoner
- Equipping a hat now saves it
- Hat can be taken on or off with input
- Hats can be swapped for other hats
- Reduced the amount of spawned enemies, to reduce being overwhelmed and trapped
- Adjusted loading UI display to be a little bit more noticeable
- Adjusted level transition area in the Canoe river
- Increased the top speed of the Canoe

Fixes

- Fixed an issue where holding Focus and entering photomode could glitch the camera
- Fixed a rare soft lock during cutscenes
- Fixed an issue where toggling photomode while starting musical performance would cause a glitch
- Fixed various boundary issues
- Fixed an issue where aiming the boomerang and getting on cassowary would break the camera
- Fixed an issue where starting zipline with cassowary near would cause a glitch
- Fixed an issue where the underwater weight rock could be held out of the water
- Fixed an issue where bringing Cassowary near a swinging vine could cause a glitch
- Fixed a rare issue where energy orbs could be observed in strange locations
